summary: Added a body-free graph_find core seam and a portable /graph-find command that scans bounded Git-tracked UTF-8 source in memory.
validation: 118 focused routing, retrieval, and skill tests passed
21 projection and source-package parity tests passed
real repository /graph-find invocation returned expected command, README, and test paths
repairs: Allowed different source paths to contain identical bytes while preserving unique paths.
Used ordinary prompt facets first and proof obligations only for short prompts whose facets are insufficient.
Prevented bytecode writes during normal invocation.
Forced capped or sensitive-path-excluded scans to defer and excluded sensitive paths before reading bytes.
boundaries: No repository write, network call, provider call, persistent index, daemon, or hook occurs during graph-find.
Direct fallback is not executed by graph-find. The result returns graph or defer with source pointers.
Clean installed discovery and invocation remain T050 proof.
